products.title: POLYGON - Ancient Empire
products.body_html:
Synty® Studios Presents: POLYGON – Ancient Empire

This Greek-Roman fusion asset pack is full of Buildings, Props, Weapons and Characters to start your Ancient World based game. Over 700 detailed prefabs in this pack.

◼ Key Features ◼
  • Building parts are compatible with POLYGON - Shops/ Horror Mansion/ Nighclubs.
  • Includes Monumental Island demo scene!
  • Modular buildings
  • Farmland area
  • (Character poses indicative only)

*Contents may vary between engines

    📦 Pack Content

    Characters (x11) 

    Captain Male, Farmer Female, Farmer Male, Leader Male, Politician Male, Soldier Female, Soldier Male, Upperclass Female, Upperclass Male, Worker Female, Worker Male. 

    Character Attachments (x28)  

    Including Beards, Hairs, Helmets, Cape, and Crowns. 
    Buildings (x237) 

    Including a base set of building pieces plus: Amphitheatre, Balconies, Baths, Ceilings, Doors, Floors, Pillars, Railings, Trims, Trellises, Stairs, Alcoves, Walls, Windows, etc. 

    Props (x329) 

    Including Banners, Baskets, Braziers, Brackets, Carts, Flower Bed/Pots, Fountains, Goblets, Anvil, Grinding Wheel, Kiln, Forge, Ladder, Loom, Lyre, Marble Blocks and Rubble, Murals, Symbols, Pergola, Pillows, Plinths, Pots, Rugs, Sacks, Scrolls, Tools, Seats, Sensers, Shelves, Statues, Straw Stacks, Sundials, Tables, Torches, Racks, etc. 

     Environment (x128) 

    Including Background Islands, Bushes, Cobblestones, Crops, Fences, Flowers, Garden Plants, Grasses, Ivy/Vines, Lilies, Ocean Plane, Pebbles, Roads, Rock Cliffs, Straw Fields, Trees, Clouds, Grounds, etc. 

     FX (x9) 

    Candle Flame, Dust, Fire Large and Small, Fountain Pour, Grass Blowing, Incense, Leaves, Sun Beam. 

     Weapons (x15) 

    Including Axes, Scabbards, Shields, Spears, and Swords. 

    🤖 Technical Info

    • Compatible with Unreal 4.26+

products.title: POLYGON - Sci-Fi Frontier
products.body_html:
Synty® Studios presents: POLYGON - Sci-Fi Frontier

Explore a brave new world, navigate uncharted terrain, and discover new life forms. In the desert settlement, the air is bone-dry and sounds of farming equipment and the nearby marketplace echo through the dusty streets. On the dark and humid alien planet, dense layers of flora create a warm, heavy mist, clinging to everything like a second skin. 

In Sci-Fi Frontier you’ll find two vastly different biomes and all the required gear for settlement operation and exploration of new planets, as well as a variety of characters to help, or hinder… 

Key Features:

  • 650+ unique prefabs / models
  • 2 separate demo scenes with different biomes, a bright desert settlement and a dark humid alien planet
  • 25 alien, human, and robot characters rigged and ready for animation
  • A generic assets folder with 350+ prefabs / models incl buildings, props, environment, weapons, and FX
  • Highly detailed, expansive film studio demo scene

*Contents may vary between engines

Alcoves, modular bar set, doors, foundation pads, plinths, prefab pods/buildings, rubble piles, stairs, frontier tents, towers, walls, water tower

products.title: ANIMATION - Bow Combat
products.body_html:
This pack of meticulously hand-crafted animations will accelerate your workflow, providing a cohesive collection of motions designed to integrate easily with Synty’s ANIMATION pack library.

Complete with 190 bow combat essential animations, including different stances, hits, deaths and more, each with multiple animations, smooth transitions, and FPS versions. This pack also includes 14 rigged bows, 7 quivers and 23 arrows in a variety of styles to suit your project. 

Your characters will spring to life with immersive fluidity as you unleash the power of bow combat into your project!

See this pack in action in our demo game.

◼ Key Features ◼

Animation Sets
190 Bow Combat animation FBX files, including RootMotion versions, designed for a complete combat system with smooth blending and transitions. Each animation is a separate file, allowing you to import only the animations you need into your project. 

Props
This pack contains 14 rigged bows, 7 quivers, 23 arrows in a variety of styles to suit your project. 

Gallery Scene
We’ve included a scene featuring all the animations as a separate asset, so you can easily view each individual animation.

Works with ANIMATION - Base Locomotion
This pack includes documentation to guide you on how to blend Bow Combat with Synty’s Base Locomotion animations.

ANIMATION Collection Bundle
Grab this pack as part of the ANIMATION Collection bundle containing all 6 of Synty's high quality ANIMATION packs at 50% off.

❓FAQ

Q: Does this pack work with Unity’s Mecanim Animation System?
A: Yes! However, this pack only supports Sidekicks, standard POLYGON characters, POLYGON Kids, and POLYGON Big Rig characters. ANIMATION - Bow Combat animations make use of a prop bone, an extra bone added to the hand. You may need to retarget the animations using third-party tools to get the prop bone to animate correctly on other characters.

Q: Can I use this pack with ANIMATION - Base Locomotion?
A: Yes, documentation is provided to guide you in blending ANIMATION - Bow Combat with ANIMATION - Base Locomotion. There's an example animation controller included in the Base Locomotion pack, and in this Bow Combat pack you will find transition animations for integration with Base Locomotion.

Q: Do these animations work with Synty Sidekick and POLYGON characters?
A: Yes! These animations are designed to work with Sidekick characters, standard POLYGON characters, POLYGON Kids, and POLYGON Big Rig characters.

Q: Do these animations work with characters in Synty SIMPLE packs?
A: No, these animations do not work with SIMPLE characters.

Q: Can I use the animations on my own custom rig?
A: ANIMATION - Bow Combat animations make use of a prop bone, an extra bone added to the hand. You may need to retarget the animations using third-party tools to get the prop bone to animate correctly on other character rigs even when using mecanim.

Q: Does this pack support Unreal Engine?
A: This pack does not officially support Unreal Engine. There is currently no timeline for Unreal Engine support for Synty ANIMATION products.

Q: Can the animations be used in Unreal Engine?
A: Even though Unreal Engine is not officially supported, you can import the animation FBX files into Unreal Engine, retarget them using the Unreal animations tool, and use them on the Unreal Mannequin. However no official Synty support is currently offered for this.

Your characters will be able to salute, fist bump, and flex with ease! This pack comes complete with 140 essential emote and taunt animations to help bring your project to life.

Check out a video showcase of animations in this pack on YouTube!

Animation Sets
140 animation FBX files, including RootMotion, POLYGON/Sidekick, and masculine/feminine versions. Each animation is a separate file, allowing you to import only the animations you need into your project. 

Gallery Scene

Works with ANIMATION - Base Locomotion and Unity’s Mecanim

Q: Can I use the animations on my own custom rig?
A: Only POLYGON and Sidekick rigs, and retargeting using Mecanim, are officially supported.

A: Even though Unreal Engine is not officially supported, you can import the animation FBX files into Unreal Engine, retarget them using the Unreal animations tool, and use them on the Unreal Mannequin. However no official Synty support is currently offered for this.

products.title: POLYGON - Nature Biomes - Season Two
products.body_html:
Synty® Studios presents: POLYGON - Nature Biome - Season Two

Venture into an exciting quest and witness the allure of three distinct POLYGON Biomes, all conveniently bundled for an extraordinary offer. Don't wait—grab your POLYGON Nature Biomes Season 2 Bundle today!

This bundle includes:

POLYGON - Alpine Mountain

Explore this canvas of vibrant hues, from the rich greens of pine trees to the fiery reds, all harmoniously set against the backdrop of snow-capped summits.

POLYGON - Arid Desert

Vegetation clings desperately to life, their twisted forms casting long shadows in the relentless heat. The sun-bleached colour palette captures the harsh beauty of a world forgotten by rain.

POLYGON - Enchanted Forest

Experience air humming with enchantment, where various majestic trees, adorned with gracefully gentle foliage, form a celestial canopy overhead, casting a spell of tranquility upon the moss-covered forest floor.

Expand your project
Combine all three Biomes in your project to create vast and expansive experiences. All Biomes in Season 2 are designed to work together, sharing common materials and shaders to simplify development when using them together.

POLYGON - Nature Biomes Seasons Two is also designed to look and feel perfectly integrated with Nature Biomes Season One and any Synty POLYGON pack.

This product is a bundle 
View full list of assets technical info and file formats by viewing each individual pack's store page.

products.title: Bundle - Heist City
products.body_html:
Synty Studios™ presents: The Heist City Bundle

Create your ultimate open world game with this high value, seven-pack bundle containing POLYGON - Palm City, POLYGON - Heist, POLYGON - Street Racer, POLYGON - Police Station, POLYGON - Nightclubs, POLYGON - Casino and POLYGON - Gang Warfare.

Build a vibrant neon soaked city where chaos, crime and big opportunities lie around every corner. Police fighting a constant cat and mouse battle with corruption, petty thieves and criminal masterminds. From sun-soaked shores, to bustling city centers, there's plenty of places to make a name for yourself.

Bundle includes:

POLYGON - Palm City

Welcome to a lively coastal city filled with beaches, bustling boardwalks, art deco streets, towering high-rises and colourful characters. Explore everything from the city centre to its Mediterranean-style mansion, golf club and iconic waterfront.

POLYGON - Heist

Mask up and prepare for the score of a lifetime. Rob banks and jewellery stores, breach heavily guarded vaults and clash with armed law enforcement as your carefully planned heist descends into chaos.

POLYGON - Street Racer

Take to the streets with custom vehicles built for high-speed racing. Tune your ride, burn through tyres and drift around a sprawling dockside environment filled with shipping yards, garages and industrial raceways.

POLYGON - Police Station

Bring law and order to the city with officers, detectives, police vehicles and a modular station featuring cells, offices, a crime lab, weapons room and more.

POLYGON - Nightclubs

Keep the city alive after dark with neon-soaked nightclubs, rooftop bars, packed dance floors and stylish entertainment spaces filled with partygoers, bartenders, bouncers and DJs.

POLYGON - Casino

Take a gamble in the neon-washed streets of Syn City. Build extravagant casinos, luxurious hotels, secure vaults and unforgettable entertainment venues where fortunes can change with the roll of the dice.

POLYGON - Gang Warfare

Fight for control of the city’s criminal underworld with rival gangs, industrial hideouts, suspicious warehouses, powerful weapons and dangerous backstreet operations.

This product is a bundle.
